# Cross TTS

Offline text-to-speech reader (EPUB / text documents, audiobook export) built
with **Electron** (main + preload + React renderer), bundled by electron-vite
and packaged with electron-builder. Package manager: pnpm. Unit tests: bun test.

Use normal Electron APIs and patterns. The `src/bun` directory name is legacy
(the project once used Electrobun); its code runs in Electron's Node main
process, not in Bun.

## Layout

- `src/bun/` — Electron main process (`index.ts`: windows, `ipcMain` handlers,
  `app://` protocol, auto-update, model hub proxy). `ttsNodeWorker.ts` is a
  separate entry started with `utilityProcess.fork` for native CPU synthesis
  (Kokoro on onnxruntime-node).
- `src/preload/` — `contextBridge` exposing `window.api` (IPC requests/events).
- `src/mainview/` — React renderer (Vite root), served via `app://bundle/`.
  Talk to the main process only through `src/mainview/lib/desktopBridge.ts`.
- `src/shared/` — pure TypeScript shared by all processes (`@shared` alias).
- `e2e/` — Playwright tests driving the Electron app.

## Commands

- `pnpm dev` — run the app in development
- `pnpm run typecheck`, `pnpm run test`, `pnpm run build`
- `pnpm run test:e2e` — Playwright (needs a display, e.g. `xvfb-run -a`)
- `pnpm run dist:linux|win|mac` — package with electron-builder (`electron-builder.yml`)
